text:
writing

I have asked, I have lost.


in this night in this world

embraced with you,

joy of shipwreck.


I wanted to sacrifice my days and my weeks

in the ceremonies of the poem.


I have implored so much

from the bottom of the bottoms

of my writing.


Fucking and dying have no adjectives.

translation.title: Writing...
translation.editorial_note: The ending keeps the original's abrupt refusal of ornament and euphemism.
